description: This is a C# source file defining the CatalogItemService class, which implements ICatalogItemService interface. It provides methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of catalog items, including listing and getting items by Id, with dependencies on other services and external HTTP calls.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Implementation of catalog item operations, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items with associated branding and type information.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via HTTP POST request.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item via HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID via HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, including brand and type names, using concurrent HTTP requests.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Lists catalog items with paging and logs the operation, then enriches items with brand and type names.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all catalog items, logging the operation and enriching items with brand and type names.
